```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path

subject    = params["subject"]
export_dir = Path(params["export_dir"])
metrics    = json.loads((export_dir / f"{subject}_metrics.json").read_text())
metrics
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

theme_mous <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1, color = "#0f172a"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "#64748b", size = base_size - 1, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "#475569", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "#64748b"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#1e293b"),
      legend.position  = "none"
    )
}

COND_COLORS <- c("ZINNEN" = "#2563eb", "WOORDEN" = "#16a34a", "REST" = "#d97706")

subject    <- params$subject
export_dir <- params$export_dir
dirs <- read_csv(
  file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_directions.csv")),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
dirs$condition <- factor(dirs$condition)
```

## Wave Direction Distributions

```{r}
#| label: fig-wave-directions
#| fig-cap: "Polar histograms of traveling-wave propagation directions, overlaid by condition. Uniform distributions indicate no directional preference."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(dirs, aes(x = direction_rad, fill = condition)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 36, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity",
                 color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~condition, nrow = 1) +
  coord_polar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COND_COLORS) +
  theme_mous() +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Traveling-wave directions –", subject),
    subtitle = "Each bin spans 10°; filled bars show count per angular bin",
    x = NULL, y = "Count"
  )
```

## Direction Density (Overlay)

```{r}
#| label: fig-wave-density
#| fig-cap: "Smoothed angular density curves for each condition overlaid on a single polar plot."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(dirs, aes(x = direction_rad, color = condition, fill = condition)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.9, bw = 0.3) +
  coord_polar() +
  scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLORS, name = "Condition") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = COND_COLORS, name = "Condition") +
  theme_mous() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Wave direction density –", subject),
    subtitle = "Smoothed KDE overlaid across conditions",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  )
```
